title: Density-adaptive ANNOUNCE_INTERVAL
description: ANNOUNCE_INTERVAL scales with local density: 300s at sparse (<5), 600s at dense (21-50), 1200s at very dense (51-100), 1800s at extreme (>100). Reuse EstimateDensity from CCP §2a.10.3. Re-evaluate on each density update; apply on next announce cycle. Spec: 05-routing.md §9.4. All three impls.
